name: Akasaka Mamoru
source:
He is a detective in the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's Public Safety Division [spoiler]who lost his wife, Yukie, five years ago. Now lives alone with his only daughter [url=/c71707]Miyuki[/url].

After the Great Hinamizawa Disaster, he cooperates with [url=/c3829]Ooishi[/url], who is working hard to solve the mystery, and visits Kakiuchi City to find out who is from Hinamizawa Village.[/spoiler] He tells [url=/c18743]Natsumi[/url] and the others that he is from the "Okinomiya Bookstore".

[Edited from [url=https://07th-expansion.fandom.com/wiki/Mamoru_Akasaka]Mamoru Akasaka[/url] on 07th Expansion Wiki]

Protagonist of Himatsubushi and one of the protagonists of Kageboushi.
